_howto: Florida Division of Elections election-night results, polled by server/src/adapters/fldos.js. 2026 general: downloadsUrl = the Florida Election Watch Downloads page (named in the Secretary of State's 2026-11 readiness release); the adapter reads that page for its own current link to fileName (?v= changes on every page load; the bare file URL serves a stale cached copy), HEADs it, and downloads the tab-delimited file only when its ETag changes. Older elections: extractUrl = the ResultsExtract.Asp download (same column layout; OfficeDesc instead of RaceName). One row per county x candidate; statewide = sum of the 67 counties. Set enabled:false to stop polling.

elections.name: Florida 2026 General (Division of Elections)
elections.note: Enabled 2026-11-04 after verifying the parsed Election Watch file (Last-Modified 01:30:03Z) against Election Watch's own Contest Results by County pages: Amendments 1-3 identical statewide and in Miami-Dade, Broward, Hillsborough; Senate and Governor identical in 66 of 67 counties incl. those three (the pages already showed a newer Columbia upload than the file). Governor rows are tickets: CanNameFirst = Governor candidate's surname, CanNameLast = running mate's, '/' in CanNameMiddle.

ticketNames.note: The results file gives tickets as surnames only (CanNameFirst = Governor candidate, CanNameLast = running mate). Full names exactly as Florida Election Watch's own Governor page lists them ('<Governor> and <Lt. Governor>'), keyed by the Governor candidate's surname in the file. A surname not listed here is shown as the surname.
